rows.en: ＊Kairi＊＠０６４＿０１８It's you...＝＠０６４＿０１９I wondered how hard someone￥must train to beat me in my￥own specialty, but...
＊Kairi＊＠０６４＿０２０I never imagined you'd be doing￥nothing at all. And someone like￥that beat me...
＊Kairi＊＠０６４＿０２１I expected anyone who could beat￥an expert would be training hard￥even on their day off.
＊Kairi＊＠０６４＿０２２I thought there might be￥something to learn from that,￥but this was a wasted trip...
＊Kairi＊＠０６４＿０２３That's not it. I just thought￥someone who beats an expert￥would be worth learning from.
＊Kairi＊＠０６４＿０２５If your scores truly are￥higher than mine...＝＠０６４＿０２６then perhaps part of the reason￥is that my own training isn't￥paying off...
＊Kairi＊＠０６４＿０２７I didn't say you look dumb.￥You simply didn't seem very￥dedicated to your training.
＊Kairi＊＠０６４＿０２９I only said what I thought...￥but I apologize.
＊Kairi＊＠０６４＿０３０Sorry to have disturbed you￥while you were relaxing.
